drill.title: Claude Developer Drill
drill.h1: Claude Certified Developer drill & mock exams
drill.intro: Scenario questions and full mock exams for Claude Certified Developer: Foundations, following the exam guide in force from 7 December 2026. The concept sets are spoken, so you can do them by voice or with the car's buttons. The mock exams follow the real format: long scenarios, with “choose two” questions mixed in.
drill.examsText: Two sets of 25 spoken scenario questions with feedback. Then two mock exams of 60 scored-style questions in 120 minutes, weighted like the v1.1 exam guide. The real exam scores on a scale with 720 to pass; the mocks use 72% as an approximation. Mock exams are touch only.

say.intro: Claude developer drill. After each question, say number one, two, three, or four, or words from the answer. Say repeat to hear the question again.
